title: SAT Study Plans: 2 Weeks, 1 Month, 3 Months
description:
How you should study for the SAT depends on how much time you have. Here are concrete plans for two weeks, one month, and three months, built only on free official resources.

You'll learn:
• The free toolkit: Bluebook full-length practice tests, My Practice, the SAT Suite Question Bank, Official SAT Prep on Khan Academy, and an error log
• What to study first when you're short on time (domain weights + your score report)
• A one-hour study session you can repeat every day
• Day-by-day and week-by-week plans for 2 weeks, 1 month, and 3 months

Any example questions shown are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. Score reports shown are illustrative, not real student data. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and the full-length practice tests in Bluebook.
